## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way
Every knowledge statement for Traffic laws, crossings, lane markings and right of way is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
Rules and penalties describe the official handbook snapshot. Detailed emergency-vehicle light lists, bus lane-count exceptions and may-versus-must wording remain explicit. The bus-camera passage is limited to the described pilot and is not treated as a statewide camera rule.
Text states railroad sign shapes and lane meanings; unreviewed illustrations are not independently validated. Cross-page sentence fragments are not promoted to standalone authority where a complete same-page statement supplies the rule elsewhere.
Open source limitation (verify DE-TRAFFIC-PILOT): The handbook describes a named school-bus camera pilot and bill-specific assessments. Current operation, coverage or amendments have not been independently verified; do not generalize this passage to all school buses or current enforcement.
Open source limitation (verify DE-TRAFFIC-VISUAL): Rail crossing, lane and interchange illustrations were not visually checked in this text-only pass. Any image-dependent recognition exercise requires source-image validation.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
